description: Productos eléctricos autorizados según RSPEBT is a series of datasets listed in Uruguayan national open data catalogue (catalogodatos.gub.uy), an open data portal, published or maintained by URSEA. Productos de baja tensión autorizados para su comercializaciòn en el marco del Reglamento de Seguridad de Productos Eléctricos de Baja Tensión. Coverage: Uruguay. The portal lists 7 near-identical datasets in this series (one per year, month, area or site), grouped in this record; the first few are linked. The portal files it under the publisher URSEA. Its tags are Autorizaciones, Baja tensión, RSPEBT, Seguridad, productos electricos. It offers 2 resource(s) in CSV. The portal shows 2024-09-23 as the last update. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Licencia de DAG de Uruguay. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support electricity network, generation and charging-infrastructure studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-am-uy-portal.
